plugins.name: A-B Repeat
plugins.description: Practice looper with native gapless A-B repeat for local 16-bit lossless audio.
plugins.author: Compás

plugins.name: ABX Blind Test
plugins.description: Blind ABX listening test with randomized X for matched audio files and parametric EQ profiles.
plugins.author: Compás

plugins.name: Album Playback Rules
plugins.description: Applies custom playback settings (gapless, crossfade, ReplayGain, play order) matched by playing track album tags.
plugins.author: Compás

plugins.name: Album Shuffle
plugins.description: Open Album Shuffle from the Music menu to play whole albums in random order while preserving track order. Confirmation switches to sequential mode; stops when you explicitly stop playback.
plugins.author: Compás

plugins.name: Audiobooks
plugins.description: Listen to audiobooks with File Manager browsing, resume, bookmarks, chapters, optional 30 second transport skipping, and a sleep timer. Includes a Reading Room player layout with 15 second seek controls and playback speed.
plugins.author: Compás

plugins.name: AutoEQ
plugins.description: Searches the AutoEQ recommended headphone catalog and saves compatible parametric EQ profiles to PEQ_Profiles.
plugins.author: Compás

plugins.name: AutoEQ Context
plugins.description: Applies parametric EQ profiles automatically based on folder, artist, or genre context.
plugins.author: Compás

plugins.name: Cover Art Fetcher
plugins.description: Fill missing album-title.jpg sidecars using MusicBrainz and the Cover Art Archive. Fetch the current album or enable automatic lookup, revert recorded downloads, and repair shared folder artwork with a confirmed, reversible rename.
plugins.author: Compás

plugins.name: Default Waveform Player
plugins.description: The Default Now Playing screen as a downloadable layout, with frosted artwork, waveform-bar seeking, and tap-to-open lyrics.
plugins.author: Compás

plugins.name: Discover
plugins.description: Find new releases, similar artists, releases missing from your collection, and manage your wish list using data from MusicBrainz and ListenBrainz.
plugins.author: buymyhubs

plugins.name: EPUB Reader
plugins.description: Reads EPUB books from the Books folder on the SD card, shown as covers, with pictures and your reading position saved.
plugins.author: Compás

plugins.name: Extended Sleep Timer
plugins.description: A longer sleep timer that remembers its duration, supports an optional quiet bedtime fade-out, and stops playback when it ends.
plugins.author: Compás

plugins.name: Gain Mode
plugins.description: Switches between the stock Low and High Gain volume curves.
plugins.author: Compás

plugins.name: Gallery Player
plugins.description: A Gallery-style Now Playing screen with frosted artwork, tap-to-open lyrics, and the standard playback controls.
plugins.author: Compás

plugins.name: Gallery Waveform Player
plugins.description: A Gallery-style Now Playing screen with frosted artwork, filled-envelope waveform seeking, and tap-to-open lyrics.
plugins.author: Compás

plugins.name: Hiby's Graph Player
plugins.description: A HiBy-style Now Playing screen with album artwork, codec and queue position, waveform seeking, and tap-to-open lyrics.
plugins.author: Compás

plugins.name: Hiby's Player
plugins.description: A HiBy-style Now Playing screen with edge-to-edge artwork, a frosted glass footer, and tap-to-open lyrics.
plugins.author: Compás

plugins.name: Home Background
plugins.description: Choose a JPG, PNG, or BMP up to 3 MB as a centered, full-screen Home wallpaper.
plugins.author: Compás

plugins.name: Jellyfin & Emby
plugins.description: Browse and stream music libraries, artists, albums, and tracks from Jellyfin and Emby media servers.
plugins.author: Compás

plugins.name: Kids Mode
plugins.description: Choose and reorder visible Home entries, Music menus, shortcuts and Quick Drawer controls, with parent PIN recovery. Hiding controls does not turn off device features. This is not a full device lock.
plugins.author: Markus Seidl

plugins.name: LastFM Scrobbler Legacy
plugins.description: Scrobbles the songs you play to your Last.fm account. Requires a free Last.fm API account and your own API credentials. Enable only one Last.fm scrobbler plugin at a time to avoid duplicate scrobbles.
plugins.author: Compás

plugins.name: LastFM Scrobbler V2
plugins.description: Scrobbles your music to Last.fm with Compás sign-in, guided setup, and an offline queue. No Last.fm API app credentials are required. Enable only one Last.fm scrobbler plugin at a time to avoid duplicate scrobbles.
plugins.author: Compás

plugins.name: LED Volume Meter
plugins.description: Shows the volume level on the charge LED, red above a high-volume threshold.
plugins.author: Compás

plugins.name: ListenBrainz Scrobbler
plugins.description: Scrobbles plays to ListenBrainz with a user token. Keeps an offline queue until each listen is accepted.
plugins.author: Compás

plugins.name: Lock Screen
plugins.description: A lock screen with album art, your own image or a clock when the screen wakes, plus an optional Power + Volume Up hardware button lock.
plugins.author: Compás

plugins.name: Lyrics Fetcher
plugins.description: Fetch synced lyrics from LRCLIB for local tracks. Skips synchronized .lrc sidecars, backs up unsynchronized ones, and can fetch from Now Playing.
plugins.author: Compás

plugins.name: MSEB
plugins.description: Stock-style sound tuning with adjustment ranges and named presets. Uses native MSEB processing on compatible firmware.
plugins.author: Compás

plugins.name: Metronome
plugins.description: Metronome with tempo, time signature, subdivision figures and three click sounds. On current players it pauses your music and leaves the queue and Now Playing untouched; older players replace what is playing.
plugins.author: Compás

plugins.name: Net Radio
plugins.description: Play saved internet radio stations from Radio.txt or search Radio Browser and save stations to the SD card.
plugins.author: Compás

plugins.name: Orbit Player
plugins.description: A dynamic Now Playing screen with circular artwork and a circular seek bar.
plugins.author: Compás

plugins.name: Output-Aware Sound
plugins.description: Applies parametric EQ profiles automatically based on output route and Bluetooth codec.
plugins.author: Compás

plugins.name: Panorama Player
plugins.description: A panoramic Now Playing screen with animated lyrics, waveform seeking, and a soft artwork fade.

plugins.name: Play Through

plugins.name: Playback Extras

plugins.author: Compás
